cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Nothing Without Stakes
cards.instruction: Price every request and decision with a reward, penalty, bargain, or trade.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: If I apologise first, what do I win?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll go first if your apology follows. We can call the argument settled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Call it a truce, then. My apology buys one evening without reopening it. Can you give me that?

reason: A offers to move first and changes the label while requiring a defined return, replacing the rhetorical first-move-risk question.
